Interface ClientCommand

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
GameCommand, LobbyCommand
All Known Implementing Classes:
ChooseColorCommand, CreateLobbyCommand, DrawCardCommand, EndTurnCommand, HeartbeatCommand, JoinLobbyCommand, LeaveCommand, ListLobbiesCommand, LobbyDisconnectCommand, PlaceTotemCommand, PlayerDisconnectedCommand, PlayerReconnectedCommand, RegisterRmiPlayerCommand, RegisterSocketPlayerCommand, SuspensionTimeoutCommand
public interface ClientCommand extends Serializable
Root of the client→server command hierarchy. Every command is Serializable because it may travel over the wire (socket/RMI) and applies the double-dispatch Visitor pattern: accept(ClientCommandVisitor) selects the command family without the caller knowing the concrete subtype.

The subtypes split into two families, each with its own second-level visitor — GameCommand with GameCommandVisitor, and LobbyCommand with LobbyCommandVisitor — plus HeartbeatCommand, handled directly at the top level.
